restMessage.name: Spring Boot Deflection API
restMessage.description: REST Message for AI Ticket Deflection Spring Boot backend

setupInstructions.step2: Create Application > Create from Scratch > Name: AI Ticket Deflection
setupInstructions.step3: Create REST Message > Name: Spring Boot Deflection API
setupInstructions.step4: Set endpoint to your LocalTunnel URL
setupInstructions.step5: Create HTTP Method > Name: resolve > Method: POST

importantNotes: Do NOT guess the REST Message internal name
Use the exact scope generated by your ServiceNow instance
The resolve method must be a child of Spring Boot Deflection API
Clear cache.do after creating/modifying REST Message
